newsitem.title: JAPAN: N.Korea's Kim makes 1st appearance since defection.
newsitem.headline: N.Korea's Kim makes 1st appearance since defection.

text.p: North Korean media on Sunday reported the first public appearance by the country's leader Kim Jong-il since the defection of a senior Pyongyang official 11 days ago.
A broadcast by official Pyongyang Radio, monitored by Tokyo-based Radiopress, reported that Kim attended a mass gymnastics display last Thursday.
Radiopress said it was the first mention in North Korea's official media of a public appearance by Kim since February 4.
In the past 11 days, North Korea has been rocked by leadership changes in which three of its 25 top leaders have disappeared from the power structure.

The communist country's premier was replaced, the defence minister died and in the greatest blow Pyongyang's ideology chief Hwang Jang yop defected to the South Korean consulate in Beijing on February 12.
